svg.title: Summit · five-minute power trend with native lap boundaries
svg.desc: 246 by 322 vector design preview, not a simulator screenshot. Synthetic power, three-second sample means, zone colors, dashed FTP reference, capped black native lap end/start boundaries, latest time at right. Current lap started 1 minute 8 seconds ago. Clock is a sample time.
